lines: Walked up from Briarbell in one go. Do not do that. I am serious.
There is a ledge halfway you can drop down on the way home.
Only on the way home, mind. It is a ledge, not a staircase.
Straight down the mine and straight back up with a Crest.
Do you know how many of you we get in here on a stretcher?
Three a month. Do not make it four. Sit down for ten minutes.
Going to the Hall? Come and see me first, not after.
It is a working mine with the machinery still in it.
The Hall has never lost anybody. I would like that sentence to stay true.
